title: 他的快乐
slug: 冰糖炖雪梨全本免费-冰糖炖雪梨最新章节列表
content_zh:
他得给她找点事情做。
课业辅导班之类的暂时不用, 他自己就能给孩子补习。
“练点活动筋骨的项目吧？比如跳舞、游泳、跆拳道？”棠妈妈和他商量。
“跆拳道肯定不行, 现在还欺负同学呢, 学了跆拳道还了得？”棠校长首先pass掉一切可能引发暴力的项目。
棠校长放学后在校门口兜了一圈, 收到宣传单若干。经过层层筛选, 并参考棠雪本人的意见，他们暂时敲定了滑冰。
于是这天，棠雪放了学就不能直接回家了, 跟着爸爸站在校门口等公交车。刚放学的校门口有点乱，熙熙攘攘的像菜市场，人车拥堵不说, 还有推着小车卖零食的。
棠雪背着小书包东张西望, 突然朝着某一处喊道：“黎语冰！”
黎语冰的妈妈看到是棠雪，领着黎语冰笑呵呵地走过来。棠雪就住在家属楼, 黎妈妈是知道的, 这会儿看到他们等公交车, 就知道不是回家, 于是问道：“这是干什么去？”
“我给她报了个班。”
“什么班呀？”
“滑冰的。”
“怎么样呀？”
“还没去呢, 今天第一堂课试滑。你要不要带黎语冰看看？试滑不收费的。”
黎妈妈觉得挺新鲜, 低头看向儿子，问道：“要不要去看看？”
黎语冰果断摇头。
黎妈妈连哄带劝，终于劝得儿子勉为其难地点了点头。黎妈妈不给他后悔的时间, 开开心心地将他拖上车。
棠雪和爸爸也有幸搭上了顺风车。
黎语冰说到做到, 答应了来看看，来了之后就真的只是看看。他端端正正地坐在室内冰场旁边的塑料排椅上，那派头，像个视察工作的领导。
教练把装备拿到他面前邀请他试试，他只有摇头。
黎妈妈有些头痛，“他最讨厌的就是运动。唉，我们家这个孩子，人小主意大，我这当妈的都劝不动他。”

棠雪换好了冰鞋和护具，跟着爸爸走上冰场。是的没错，校长大人也是会滑冰的。
然后，爸爸把她丢给教练，自己一个人去玩了。
任何一个小朋友初学滑冰，都是从摔跤开始的。棠雪在教练的指导下几乎还没挪地方呢，就“咚”的一下摔倒在冰面上。
场外的黎语冰抿嘴笑。
棠雪没哭，站起来继续滑，过不久又摔一跤，咚。
黎语冰笑得眼睛都亮了。
然后就是棠雪不停地摔，黎语冰不停地笑，后来还忍不住鼓掌了。
黎妈妈额角滴汗，恨铁不成钢地推了一把他的脑袋：“你个傻小子！不给人家加油就算了，哪有鼓掌的？！”
不管怎么说，黎语冰对滑冰这项运动的好感度蹭蹭蹭暴涨，以至于他都愿意亲自尝试一下了。
黎语冰换上装备，进场，然后毫无意外，第一步也是摔跤。
棠雪：“哈哈哈哈哈！”
假如没有棠雪在旁边幸灾乐祸，他可能摔一两跤觉得不好玩也就放弃了，可偏偏有这样一个讨厌的家伙聒噪着，他有些负气了，摔倒就爬起来继续，一边总结经验一边按照教练讲授的去做，这样过了不一会儿，竟然不再摔跤了。
然后他滑着冰在棠雪面前经过，动作不算流畅，表情绝对镇定，装逼技能满分。
“咦？”棠雪有些惊奇。
黎语冰背着手，留给棠雪一个高深莫测的背影。
“你是怎么做到的呀？”棠雪追上去，一着急，咚的一下又摔了，她忍不住“哎呦”一声。
黎语冰一边滑一边笑，又不敢笑得太明显，便只是浅浅地牵着嘴角。
总之，他的快乐就是建立在她的痛苦之上。
棠校长滑着冰经过教练身边，听到教练在感叹：“悟性不错。”
棠校长挺开心的：“你说我们家丫头？”

“不是，我说那个小男孩。”教练抬了抬下巴，看着黎语冰的背影。
“那我们家的呢？”棠校长不甘心地追问。
教练想了一下，尽量地寻找了一些优点：“皮实，禁摔。”
棠校长好生气：“你当她是诺基亚吗……”

content_en:
He had to find something for her to do.
There is no need for tutoring classes or the like for the time being, so he can tutor his children by himself.
"How about practicing something to move your muscles? For example, dancing, swimming, taekwondo?" Tang's mother discussed with him.
"Taekwondo is definitely not good. Now you are still bullying your classmates. How can you be good after learning taekwondo?" Principal Tang first passed all events that may cause violence.
Principal Tang took a walk around the school gate after school and received several leaflets. After many rounds of screening and considering Tang Xue's own opinions, they tentatively decided on skating.
So on this day, Tangxue couldn't go home directly after school. She followed her father and stood at the school gate waiting for the bus. The school gate just after school was a bit chaotic, bustling like a vegetable market, not to mention crowded with people and cars, and there were people pushing small carts selling snacks.
Tangxue was looking around with her small schoolbag on her back, and suddenly shouted to a certain place: "Li Yubing!"
Li Yubing's mother saw it was Tang Xue and led Li Yubing over with a smile. Tangxue lived in the family building, and Li's mother knew it. When she saw them waiting for the bus, she knew they were not going home, so she asked, "What are you doing here?"
"I signed her up for a class."
"What class is it?"
"Skating."
"How's it going?"
"I haven't gone yet. The first lesson today is trial skating. Do you want to show Li Yubing? There is no charge for trial skating."
Li's mother thought it was quite new. She looked down at her son and asked, "Would you like to go and have a look?"
Li Yubing shook his head decisively.
Mother Li coaxed and persuaded, and finally persuaded her son to reluctantly nod. Mother Li didn't give him time to regret, and happily dragged him into the car.
Tangxue and her father were also lucky enough to catch a ride.
Li Yubing kept his promise and agreed to come and have a look. After he came, he really just had a look. He was sitting upright on a plastic bench next to the indoor ice rink, looking like a leader inspecting work.
The coach brought the equipment to him and invited him to try it, but he could only shake his head.
Li's mother had a headache. "What he hates most is exercise. Alas, this child in our family has big ideas, and even a mother like me can't persuade him."
Tangxue changed into skates and protective gear and followed her father onto the ice rink. Yes, that's right, the principal can also skate.
Then, the father left her to the coach and went to play alone.
When any child first learns to skate, he or she starts with wrestling. Tangxue barely moved her position under the guidance of the coach when she fell onto the ice with a thud.
Li Yubing outside the court pursed her lips and smiled.
Tangxue didn't cry, she stood up and continued skating. Not long after, she fell again, bang.
Li Yubing smiled so hard that his eyes lit up.
Then Tang Xue kept falling, and Li Yubing kept laughing, and later he couldn't help but applaud.
Mother Li had sweat dripping from her forehead and pushed him on the head angrily: "You silly boy! If you don't cheer for others, how can you applaud?!"
In any case, Li Yubing's favorability for the sport of skating has skyrocketed, so much so that he is willing to try it himself.
Li Yubing put on his equipment, entered the arena, and without any surprise, the first step was wrestling.
Tang Xue: "Hahahahaha!"
If Tangxue hadn't been there to gloat about his misfortune, he might have fallen once or twice and decided it wasn't fun and given up. However, there was such an annoying guy making noises. He felt a little frustrated, so he got up after falling and continued, summarizing his experience while doing what the coach taught him. After a while, he stopped wrestling.
Then he passed by Tang Xue on the ice. His movements were not smooth, his expression was absolutely calm, and his pretentious skills were perfect.
"Huh?" Tangxue was a little surprised.
Li Yubing held his hands behind his back, leaving Tang Xue with an unpredictable figure.
"How did you do that?" Tangxue chased after her. When she got anxious, she fell again with a thud. She couldn't help but said "Ouch"A sound.
Li Yubing smiled while skating, but he didn't dare to smile too obviously, so he just lightly held the corners of his mouth.
In short, his happiness is based on her pain.
Principal Tang passed by the coach while skating and heard the coach sigh: "Good understanding."
Principal Tang was very happy: "Are you talking about our girl?"
"No, I'm talking about that little boy." The coach raised his chin and looked at Li Yubing's back.
"What about our family?" Principal Tang asked reluctantly.
The coach thought for a moment and tried his best to find some advantages: "Solid skin, no wrestling allowed."
Principal Tang was so angry: "Do you think she is Nokia..."
